world_camera_impostors — DRIVE humanoid op

• Data kinds: table × matrix × matrix → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.world_camera_impostors(world: 'dict', pose, K, width: 'int' = 640, height: 'int' = 400, actors=(), **camera_kw) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import drivehumanoid; drivehumanoid.world_camera_impostors(world: 'dict', pose, K, width: 'int' = 640, height: 'int' = 400, actors=(), **camera_kw) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("world_camera_impostors"))

Usage

Captures the world with driveworld.world_camera and pastes the impostors of actors comparing front and back by depth.

actors = [{"imp": humanoid_impostors の返り値, "x", "y", "yaw", "distance" (歩いた距離 [m])}, …]. Heading step = the camera azimuth as seen from the body, rounded to n_yaw steps; phase = the step nearest to the remainder of the walked distance divided by the period. Scale = the actual camera's "pixels per 1 m" / the pre-render's "pixels per 1 m" (nearest-neighbour scaling). Returns the same keys as world_camera. Pasted pixels get label = the object's label (7), face = −2 (no triangle), shade = 1. In addition "impostor_pixels" (number of pasted pixels).

Empty input (world an empty dict) raises ValueError.
